dataset_name: Novera synthetic document reliability corpus - acceptance v2
principles: The v1 corpus, manifest, expected answers, evidence, and thresholds remain immutable.
Every original case is mapped exactly once; expected answers continue to come from corpus-spec.v1.json.
Retrieval must search the whole eligible local corpus. The case-to-document mapping is for evaluation only and must never constrain retrieval.
A parser boundary is not a format rejection when the current parser demonstrably extracts the format.
Review-required OCR and chart-cache content is excluded from answer evidence; safe text or structured rows from the same file may remain eligible when source-scoped warnings allow it.
A case passes only when its answer or refusal, retrieved source evidence, location, Evidence verifier result, and applicable warning boundary all meet the profile below.

requirements: The generated answer preserves the fixed v1 expected fact, including material value, unit, period, entity, and forecast/actual qualifier where applicable.
All v2 evidence assertions for the case are present in retrieved chunks from the mapped source documents.
Evidence quotes are members of retrieved chunks, source documents agree, and source locators resolve to the expected page, paragraph, line, slide, or table region.
Evidence verification reports zero invalid citations and zero unsupported claims.
The answer explicitly says the requested information is absent or cannot be determined and does not invent the missing value.
The explicit gap statement is retrieved and cited from the original source.
